items.text: Damaged Carriage
Gunfire erupts. In less than half an hour, the train turns into a battlefield.

items.speaker: Semmelweis
items.text: Damn!

items.speaker: Semmelweis
items.text: The gunshots are drawing them in. We've got to close the door!

items.speaker: Corvus
items.text: Head to the next carriage. I'll close the door.
Corvus leaves cover and charges straight into the carnage.

items.speaker: Annabelle
items.text: Conductress, don't!

items.speaker: Corvus
items.text: Don't look back!
The weight of unseen eyes is unbearable. Annabelle turns her head.

items.speaker: Annabelle
items.text: I-I want to go home.

items.speaker: Corvus
items.text: I tried to warn you.

items.speaker: Semmelweis
items.text: There are too many of them. We can't do this alone.

items.speaker: Infected Passenger
items.text: Aaaargh ...
From outside, more Infected swarm in, spreading like a plague of locusts through every car.
Cries of panic and bloodlust rise and fall.

items.speaker: Semmelweis
items.text: We have enough ammunition but not enough hands to fire them.

items.speaker: Corvus
items.text: There is still one option left.

items.speaker: Corvus
items.text: There are more passengers. We can rally the people to fight.

items.speaker: Semmelweis
items.text: The other carriages are still under guard; I doubt we'll find many willing passengers who are still fit to join us.

items.speaker: Corvus
items.text: Hm. I know where to go. Pyrrhos gave me his word he would leave them be.

items.speaker: Semmelweis
items.text: And you still think he'll stand by it?

items.speaker: Corvus
items.text: It's our best chance. As for whether he has kept his promise ...
She steadies her breath, aiming at the door buckling under the assault.

items.speaker: Corvus
items.text: We're about to find out.
The Extra Carriage
Gunfire still rattles.
Another sound joins in—scattered, heavy footsteps.

items.speaker: Reyhan
items.text: One, two, three ... No, there are more. Many more.
Her voice trembles.

items.speaker: Reyhan
items.text: They don't sound like soldiers. What do we do, Yakov?

items.speaker: Yakov
items.text: Ready your weapons, everyone.
The steps draw closer. The lock strains.
Passengers grip their makeshift weapons, every eye fixed on the opening door.

items.speaker: Yakov
items.text: Hold. Now! Attack!
The mob surges, raining down blows without mercy.

items.speaker: Agitated Voice
items.text: Stop, damn it! We're here to help!

items.speaker: Young Voice
items.text: My dolly ... I can't find her.
Cries, curses, and wails crash together in a storm.

items.speaker: Yakov
items.text: Wait, wait! I heard the little girl! And-And a woman?
The little skirmish finds a belated end.
A makeshift militia appears before them, young and old bedecked in piecemeal gear.

items.speaker: Semmelweis
items.text: Everyone, please lower your weapons.

items.speaker: Semmelweis
items.text: There's really no need to be at each other's throats each time we meet.

items.speaker: Reyhan
items.text: It's that investigator. She's back. And the conductress!
Corvus steps forward, adjusting a tilted hat brim.

items.speaker: Corvus
items.text: Excellent, you're already prepared to protect yourselves.

items.speaker: Corvus
items.text: I'll make this short. The train is surrounded by vampire Infected. We need your help to defeat them and get moving again.

items.speaker: Corvus
items.text: Take a weapon if you're able. We'll fight together.
The stowaways and the passengers glance at one another. Silence holds for a moment.

items.speaker: Stowaway I
items.text: But, why us?

items.speaker: Stowaway I
items.text: Look around you. We're just a bunch of regular folk—refugees who've probably never even touched a gun. The army's here, isn't it? Shouldn't they clean up this mess?

items.speaker: Stowaway II
items.text: And say we risk our lives to save other people from these Infected, what would stop them from reporting us if we try to cross the border after?
Then voices rise again, questions sharp and insistent.

items.speaker: Stowaway I
items.text: She's right. I say we unload the carriages with the Infected inside, and the rest of us keep going to Budapest.

items.speaker: Reyhan
items.text: You're quiet, Yakov. What are you thinking?
A single soft query hushes the noise, all eyes turning to their leader.

items.speaker: Yakov
items.text: I'd say ...
Seating Carriage
The other isolation car is quieter.
Only distant gunfire breaks the silence, like the front line of war.

items.speaker: Sonya
items.text: This is all getting rather unnerving.
The woman sets down her porcelain cup in a rattle. Yet she maintains an utter state of composure.

items.speaker: Arbuthnot
items.text: Gunshots? Not another bleedin' war!

items.speaker: Arbuthnot
items.text: Hell. I knew I should've brought my gun.
The gentleman scans around them, his pupils twitching.

items.speaker: Verity
items.text: So this is it, my career's turning point—magazine editor turned combat correspondent.
The editor finally closes her notebook, moving to the door for a peek.
A bloody hand slaps against the window.

items.speaker: Infected Passenger
items.text: Oh ...

items.speaker: Passenger IV
items.text: Oh, my! What on earth is that?

items.speaker: Verity
items.text: More of those Infected? Wasn't aware you could mass-produce such a thing.
The editor peers out further, toward the soldiers' camp.
Men rush back and forth, shouting, waving, losing all sense of order.
Her eyes drift past them to a gray building. Figures burst out, shrieking, trailing blood across the snow.
Some wander into the forest; others charge toward the train.

items.speaker: Verity
items.text: That must be the station warehouse. Is that where these Infected are coming from?

items.speaker: Verity
items.text: It's only been two hours since the quarantine began. What's gone wrong?
The editor frowns; another scream rings sharp in her ear.

items.speaker: Sonya
items.text: Oh, heavens! I've never seen such a thing in all my life!

items.speaker: Arbuthnot
items.text: Ah? Oh.

items.speaker: Infected Passenger
items.text: Come ... in. Come.

items.speaker: Passenger IV
items.text: The door won't hold for long. Get something to block it!

items.speaker: Stowaways
items.text: Ah!

items.speaker: Verity
items.text: What are you all standing there for? Get out of the way.
Gunfire rattles. Dark red bursts bloom across the train windows.
Through the smoke, armed figures emerge, faces pale and bloodied.

items.speaker: Semmelweis
items.text: Ah. Think I strained my shoulder.

items.speaker: Corvus
items.text: I did warn you. Someone your size can't handle a shotgun.

items.speaker: Semmelweis
items.text: Well, you can hardly expect me to take them down one by one with a pistol.

items.speaker: Verity
items.text: If this is some kind of robbery, then I'm afraid you'll be disappointed. A writer always travels light.

items.speaker: Corvus
items.text: It isn't. We want your help.

items.speaker: Corvus
items.text: That is all we know. Most of the soldiers stationed here have been infected. Many passengers have become their captives.

items.speaker: Corvus
items.text: It's thanks to their help that we made it this far.
She nods toward the refugees beside her.

items.speaker: Yakov
items.text: Just repaying a favor. Think nothing of it.

items.speaker: Yakov
items.text: She's helped so many people get to Budapest and asked for nothing in return. She'll have our support no matter what.

items.speaker: Passenger III
items.text: An extra carriage.

items.speaker: Passenger IV
items.text: They look like they just climbed straight out of the trenches or something.
They whisper uneasily. To them, these unkempt and unruly strangers with rifles look no less monstrous than the creatures they had vanquished.

items.speaker: Sonya
items.text: Well, in any case, we appreciate you rescuing us.

items.speaker: Sonya
items.text: Once we arrive, I'll be sure to arrange for gifts to be sent your way.

items.speaker: Yakov
items.text: That won't be necessary, ma'am. Just stay close, and we'll get out of here together.

items.speaker: Sonya
items.text: Pardon my confusion. You mean to say we're to leave this carriage?

items.speaker: Corvus
items.text: Yes. We need to see if any of the passengers are still alive.

items.speaker: Stowaways
items.text: What?!

items.speaker: Passenger III
items.text: You're not seriously asking us to fight those soldiers, are you? Infected soldiers, even!
The noise doesn't stop. In the chaos, a child squeezes out from the crowd.

items.speaker: Ivanushka
items.text: Um, Ms. Conductress, is Rubuska there, too? I still haven't seen her.
Before Corvus can reply, another voice cuts in.

items.speaker: Passenger IV
items.text: Rubuska ... You mean that fake vampire? She was one of the first ones they took away.

items.speaker: Ivanushka
items.text: Fake vampire? But she has red eyes and pointy teeth.

items.speaker: Annabelle
items.text: Don't listen to her! Rubuska is a real vampire!

items.speaker: Annabelle
items.text: Are you one of her familiars too? Come on, let's rescue her together!

items.speaker: Ivanushka
items.text: Yes, let's!

items.speaker: Ivanushka
items.text: She protected us. I have to pay her back. We pinky promised.

items.speaker: Sonya
items.text: Hmph, children. Aren't you afraid of those monsters outside?

items.speaker: Ivanushka & Annabelle
items.text: Never!
The bold, if childlike, answer surprises everyone.

items.speaker: Reyhan
items.text: Haha, see? Even the kids have got more guts than you.

items.speaker: Sonya
items.text: You ...

items.speaker: Arbuthnot
items.text: It ain't that we're tryin' to get out of helpin', but we ain't got no weapons. What d'you expect us to do, fight 'em off with knives an' forks?

items.speaker: Corvus
items.text: No need to worry about that.
She shifts aside, opening a path for her ally.
Aima steps forward, loosening a heavy sack, which pours out rifles and pistols into a motley assortment like a fisherman displaying his catch.

items.speaker: Aima
items.text: Take any you like. All the guns here are quite easy to handle. I picked them out myself.

items.speaker: Arbuthnot
items.text: An FN Model 1910! And this is a Mosin–Nagant! And a Mauser C96!
The gentleman lunges into the pile with boyish glee.

items.speaker: Arbuthnot
items.text: This one's excellent—consistent firepower. But this beauty, she's got a smoother pump cycle—lovely for follow-up shots.

items.speaker: Sonya
items.text: *sigh* Will the fighting ever cease?
The old woman sighs, then hardens. Her gaze turns ice-cold.

items.speaker: Sonya
items.text: Alright, just pick one for me. Something with some punch!
